subject: Vaulted Health — request for sandbox subsidy + isolation evidence
messages:
From: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@vaultedhealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@vaultedhealth.com>, vault-security@vaultedhealth.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot subsidy & evidence for Private VPC POC

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Vaulted is excited to run a short Private VPC pilot to validate inference latency and encrypted key handling for our clinical routing use case. Security has asked for a clear path to a small subsidy (credits) to cover the POC compute while we complete an audit.

What we can provide now: a SOC 2 Type II summary, a network segmentation diagram, and an MOU committing to an isolated subnet for the pilot. We expect the technical onboarding to take ~2 weeks.

Request: a one-time credit of $12,000 (or equivalent tokens) and an extension of the 30-day trial window to 60 days for the Private VPC trial. Credits would be tied to the POC account and only consumable within the sandboxed nodes.

Can Redwood approve? If helpful, I can put our security lead on a call.

–Rebecca
Director of Engineering
Vaulted Health
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@vaultedhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot subsidy & evidence for Private VPC POC

Rebecca —

Appreciate the clear ask and the quick turnaround on evidence. We can make a conditional credit commitment for the Private VPC pilot. High-level terms I can sign off on immediately:

- One-time credit: $12,000 applied to the POC account.
- Trial extension: 60 days total from activation.
- Condition: credits are released after we receive the SOC 2 Type II summary (the one-page summary is fine) and the network segmentation diagram showing isolated subnets + NAT/firewall rules.
- KMS: confirm that Vaulted will use customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) or a KMS integration; if you need Redwood KMS with HSM, that requires additional paperwork.

I cc'd Lauren and Markus to confirm procurement and legal sign-off on our side. Once we have those two items uploaded to the Drive link and our security team does a quick spot-check, I will trigger the credit allocation and extend the trial window.

Would you be able to upload the SOC2 summary and the diagram today or tomorrow? If Vaulted wants a short 30-minute sync with our security PM, we can schedule it.

Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot subsidy & evidence for Private VPC POC

Vivek / Markus —

Quick notes from procurement/legal:

- We can approve the $12k credit conditional on the evidence Vivek outlined.
- Need to attach the signed MOU (simple one-pager) to the HubSpot deal before finance releases the credit. I'll upload a standard MOU template to the HS record and ask Vaulted to sign.
- If Vaulted requests customer-managed KMS, we don't need extra controls. If they want Redwood-managed HSM, that's escalatable and will add ~2 weeks.

Markus, please greenlight from security once you do the spot-check. If you need a sample redaction checklist for the SOC2 summary, I can provide one.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Revenue Ops
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@vaultedhealth.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: Vaulted Health POC credits & next steps

Rebecca / team —

Thanks for sending the artifacts earlier this morning (SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf, network-segmentation-diagram.png, MOU_vaulted-pilot.docx). I completed the security spot-check:

- SOC2 summary covers CC1/CC6/CC7 for the latest period; redactions are acceptable and we do not require full reports for this POC.
- Network diagram shows a dedicated VPC with private subnets and no public routing to the inference hosts; firewall rules documented.
- MOU includes a clause that Redwood controls the model-serving endpoints and credits are only usable within the named pilot account.

Approval: Security & Revenue Ops approve the conditional credit. Vivo (finance ops) — please allocate $12,000 in credits to the Vaulted Health POC account RDW-4319-PILT. Lauren — please attach the signed MOU to HS-9876 and finalize billing flags (non-billable credit).

We should also schedule a 30-min handoff between your security lead and our platform security PM to validate key handling for launch. Rebecca, can you share a couple of windows next week?

Markus Klein
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
